svg.title: How the blueprint bot brings a new release to its open pull request
svg.desc: If the open pull request has commits of anyone but the release app, the branch stays as it is and the bot says once that a newer release is out. Otherwise the bot makes the commit of the new update on main, signed by GitHub and with the mode of every file, and moves the branch straight from the update before to the new commit, so the pull request stays open with its number.
